# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest published release.

## Report a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities through [support@xquik.com](mailto:support@xquik.com).

Do not open public issues for secrets, credential handling defects, private
data exposure, request manipulation, or package supply-chain concerns.

We acknowledge reports within 3 business days. We coordinate a
disclosure timeline after confirming the issue.

## Scope

Security-sensitive areas include credentials, requests, responses, node
metadata, dependencies, and releases.
